newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Boehler acquires local rival.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Boehler acquires local rival.

text.p: Austrian high-grade steelmaker Boehler-Uddeholm said on Wednesday it had taken over Austrian family firm Martin Miller AG for an undisclosed sum.
In a statement, Boehler said the acquisition of Traismauer-based Martin Miller would contribute to the expansion of the group's core strip steel business.

"Because the operations of the two companies are highly complementary, Boehler-Uddeholm anticipates significant earnings growth potential in its strip steel business," Boehler said, emphasising potential in eastern Europe and Asia.

Last year, Martin Miller had a turnover of 356 million schillings, of which exports accounted for 75 percent, and a pre-tax profit of 14 million. It employs 300 people and is active in Europe, the United States and Asia.
Martin Miller's sales and earnings this year were expected to exceed 1996 levels, Boehler said. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
